'''Crafting''' is the process of creating new items from [[:c:Crafting Materials|Crafting Materials]]. [[Manual Crafting]] can be done anywhere, but most recipes require a [[:Category:Workshops|Workshop]], such as a [[Workbench]], or [[Survivors#Craftspeople|Craftspeople]].

==Workshops==

<div style="overflow:auto;”>
{{Crafting Equipment
|Manual Crafting
|Workbench
}}
{{Footnote|Manual Crafting can be done from anywhere, as long as you have the materials to craft the items in your inventory, or if you are within the range of a [[Storage#Magic Chests|magic chest]] with the required materials.}}
</div>
